what: Beside each title word, a .12em dot (every third is a square, the rest circles) appears first, swelling 1→1.5→2x and then vanishing. In its place the word grows stepwise .35→.65→1x and reclaims its position, offset by .08em, in .25s — 1s per word, each word .12s later, blooming from the left and right ends alternately by odd and even. Plays once when 15% of the section is visible

options.threshold: How much must be visible to start (0 to 1), default .15
options.[data-fx-part=word]: Word (child) — if absent, the text is split on spaces into words
options.--fx-ink: Word and dot color (CSS variable), default currentColor

from.where: shared.js wordBloom (Hero · carousel · City titles’ [data-reveal=/  headline]) — original wr-shape·wr-text keyframes 1s step-end, word .12s, push .25s ease-out after .55s
